description: This file defines a singleton object TvWebViewKeyHelper which provides a utility method to handle DPAD key inputs for scrolling a WebView on TV devices with remote controls. It primarily manages paging behavior for WebViews based on key events.

classes.name: TvWebViewKeyHelper
classes.description: A singleton object providing key handling utility for WebViews on TV, specifically for paging via remote control keys.

methods.name: handleKeyForPaging
methods.description: Handles DPAD key events to scroll WebView vertically by a page step (80% of viewport height). It responds to KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN and KEYCODE_DPAD_UP, scrolling the WebView accordingly on ACTION_DOWN events.
